name: Effort
q: Heaven helps those who help themselves
Diligence is the mother of good luck
Study like digging a well, go all the way
Half-steps accumulate into a thousand miles
If I stop, I stop myself
Focus the mind; nothing stays undone
Genius is a transcendent capacity for taking trouble
Before excellence, the gods have placed sweat
Whoever strives with all his might, him we can redeem
We dare not, and so things are hard
They can because they think they can
